root_cause: The earlier Supabase pressure recovery removed cron-herd amplification and bounded bg-interactie, but public CMS reads and growth-event ingestion still mapped visitor requests synchronously to Supabase Edge/Data API calls. During a new PostgREST/Supavisor degradation window this produced 963 cms_content_items 522s, 1224 bg_growth_ingest_event 522s, and 960 portal-state-eu 500s in two hours.
prevention: Public CMS reads use a 2.5s origin budget, 30s shared circuit breaker and stale cache; the growth visitor path only writes a durable Netlify Blob queue, while a one-minute bounded drain persists at most ten records and stops after the first backend failure.
